name: calendar
description: A source-owned compositional date-grid calendar with single and range selection.

documentation.compositionNote: The copied façade styles the month view, navigation, title, and generated date grid with semantic shadcn tokens while the owned primitive retains single/range selection, constraints, keyboard navigation, focus, and ARIA behavior. Less common month/year selector parts remain composable exports.
documentation.usage: Calendar { value: value(), on_value_change: move |v| value.set(v) }
documentation.accessibility: `CalendarGridRoot` is `role="grid"`, each week is `role="row"`, and each day is a focusable button whose label states its full weekday/month/day/year; the weekday header row is `aria-hidden` since each day's own label already carries the weekday; the month/year heading is `role="heading" aria-level="2"` (`packages/adico-primitives/src/calendar.rs`, WAI-ARIA APG Grid pattern).
documentation.keyboard: Days share a single-tab-stop roving tabindex with arrow-key navigation across the grid; `RangeCalendar` additionally exposes `data-selection-start`/`data-selection-between`/`data-selection-end` per day for a two-endpoint range.
